tables.name: analysis_run
tables.comment: One run of the floor-plan analyser over an uploaded image: what it was asked, what each step reported, how it ended.

checks.name: analysis_run_check
checks.def: CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at >= started_at)))

tables.name: audit_event
tables.comment: Append-only record of who did what. Written by the API. Partition by month (on occurred_at) when it grows.

tables.name: bom_line
tables.comment: The bill of materials of a design version: what to buy, in what quantity. Derived from the design; the basis of quotes and stock checks.

tables.name: catalogue_item
tables.comment: Items a design can use and a quote can price. organisation_id NULL is the platform catalogue; an organisation may add its own.

tables.name: client
tables.comment: Who the work is for: the homeowner or builder's customer a quote goes to.

tables.name: electrical_brief
tables.comment: The project brief for a plan's electrical design: supply, construction, appliances, preferences. Each design version keeps a snapshot.

tables.name: electrical_design_input
tables.comment: The exact floor-plan versions (one per level) an electrical design was made from.

tables.name: electrical_design_version
tables.comment: An electrical design (the ElectricalDesign JSON), versioned like floor plans. Records the rule pack, policy and engine that made it, so it can be reproduced.

tables.name: electrical_licence
tables.comment: A person's electrical licence. A review is signed off under one, recorded on the review as it stood then.

tables.name: electricity_distributor
tables.comment: Distribution network service providers (DNSPs). Their service rules decide supply limits and consumer mains.

tables.name: external_reference
tables.comment: This app's row <-> the same thing in another system, e.g. a quote and its Planna One sales quote, a catalogue item and its SKU.

tables.name: floor_plan_version
tables.comment: A floor plan (the FloorPlan JSON the editor works on), versioned. The editor saves into the one draft; committing freezes it.

columns.name: document
columns.comment: The FloorPlan document in millimetres, as defined by contracts/floor-plan.schema.json. The source of truth for geometry.

columns.name: floor_area_m2
columns.comment: Derived from document when saved, so lists and reports need not open the JSON.

tables.name: organisation
tables.comment: A customer of the SaaS: the tenant. Everything a business creates belongs to one.

columns.name: abn
columns.comment: Australian Business Number, 11 digits, no spaces.

columns.name: seat_limit
columns.comment: People the licence covers. Owners, admins, builders and electricians use a seat (active members and pending invitations); viewers never do. Set by the operator; a trial has 3.

columns.name: licence_starts_on
columns.comment: First day of the licence period.

columns.name: licence_ends_on
columns.comment: Last day of the licence period, after which the company becomes read-only (suspended). NULL: no end date. A trial ends 14 days after it starts.

columns.name: closed_at
columns.comment: When the licence was closed. The company's data is deleted 90 days later.

columns.name: token_sha256
columns.comment: SHA-256 of the invitation token. The token itself is only ever in the email.

checks.name: organisation_invitation_check
checks.def: CHECK (((accepted_at IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NULL)))

tables.name: organisation_member
tables.comment: Who belongs to which organisation, and as what. The role decides what the API lets them do.

tables.name: organisation_policy
tables.comment: An organisation's overrides of design-policy rules (switch heights, outlets per room...). Never mandatory rules.

tables.name: plan
tables.comment: One house design within a project (a project may have several: Lot 12 Type A, Lot 13 Type B). Carries the lifecycle stage.

columns.name: lock_version
columns.comment: Optimistic locking: the API updates WHERE lock_version = :seen and increments it, so two editors cannot silently overwrite each other.

tables.name: plan_level
tables.comment: A storey of a plan, each with its own floor plan. Ordinal 0 is ground, 1 first floor, -1 basement.

tables.name: plan_stage
tables.comment: The stages a house plan moves through, in display order.

tables.name: plan_stage_event
tables.comment: Every stage a plan has been in, who moved it and why. Written only by the triggers on electriplan.plan.

tables.name: plan_stage_transition
tables.comment: Every move a plan may make. A trigger on electriplan.plan refuses any other. Change the workflow by changing these rows.

checks.name: price_list_check
checks.def: CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_from IS NULL) OR (valid_to >= valid_from)))

tables.name: price_list_item
tables.comment: What an organisation pays (cost) and charges (price) for an item, and the labour it takes to install.

tables.name: project
tables.comment: A job at one site, for one client. Holds one or more house plans.

columns.name: reference
columns.comment: Human-readable, unique per organisation: PRJ-000042. From electriplan.next_reference.

tables.name: project_assignee
tables.comment: Who is working on a project and in what capacity. Every member of the organisation can still see it.

tables.name: quote
tables.comment: A priced offer to a client for one house plan, pricing one committed design version of it. Revisions keep the reference (Q-000107 rev 2) and supersede the one before. Totals are kept by trigger from the lines.

checks.name: quote_check1
checks.def: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['sent'::text, 'accepted'::text, 'declined'::text, 'expired'::text])) OR (sent_at IS NOT NULL)))

tables.name: review
tables.comment: A licensed electrician's review of one committed design version. Approval is the sign-off the plan's lifecycle waits for.

checks.name: review_check1
checks.def: CHECK (((status <> 'approved'::text) OR ((reviewer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewer_licence_id IS NOT NULL) AND (licence_snapshot IS NOT NULL))))

tables.name: review_finding
tables.comment: What the reviewer did with each item (kept, moved, removed, added) and any comment. Feeds the "90% accepted unchanged" measure.

columns.name: item_ref
columns.comment: The id of a point or circuit in the design document, e.g. lt_001 or c_L1.

tables.name: rule_pack
tables.comment: A version of the rules the electrical engine applies (shipped with the API). Released only once a licensed electrician has signed it off.

columns.name: standards
columns.comment: The editions it encodes, e.g. {"AS/NZS 3000": "2018+A3", "VIC SIR": "2024"}.

checks.name: rule_pack_check
checks.def: CHECK (((status <> 'released'::text) OR ((signed_off_by IS NOT NULL) AND (released_at IS NOT NULL))))

tables.name: stored_file
tables.comment: Metadata for every file the app keeps. The bytes live in object storage (or on disk in development) under storage_key.

columns.name: sha256
columns.comment: Content hash: finds a plan uploaded twice, and proves a file has not changed.

tables.name: supabase_user
tables.comment: Read-only copy of Supabase Auth users (auth.users). Supabase is the source of truth; only the API's sync writes here.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: The Supabase user id: auth.users.id and the access token's sub.

columns.name: copied_at
columns.comment: When a change in Supabase was last copied into this row.

tables.name: user_profile
tables.comment: What this app keeps about a person beyond Supabase: display name, the organisation they land in, preferences.
